Read recorded token usage and coverage

Usage: mj usage [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>        Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --session <SESSION>      Read one session, including accounting retained after cleanup
      --no-splash              Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
      --parent <PARENT>        Read this session and every descendant, including cleaned-up children
      --after-seq <AFTER_SEQ>  Return entries after this sequence number (one session only)
      --limit <LIMIT>          Most entries to return in one page (one session only)
      --json                   Print the response as JSON instead of text
  -h, --help                   Print help
